# Silent film recipe

Idea: a silent comedy drawn like an engraving and shown in a movie palace. Pen line over silver wash. The 4:3 print jitters and flickers between velvet drapes. Black title cards replace voices. One deadpan figure plays a whole gag in a single locked wide shot.

## Format

A one-reel film as seen projected.
- Aspect: 1440x1080 (4:3) picture, centred in a 1920x1080 frame. The remaining sides are the picture house, with the gate between theatre curtains.
- Surface: an ink drawing with grey wash and hatching, printed on silver stock that flickers, weaves, scratches and darkens at the edges.
- No one speaks. Wide-shot action and intertitle cards carry every beat.
- The gag is one take: a small cause, a chain reaction, a held face. Waiting is the joke.
- Not this: noir (hard shadow as mood), a sepia filter over modern animation (the drawing itself must be inked and hatched), a tramp pastiche (no bowler, toothbrush moustache or cane; no gags lifted from a real film).

## Drawing method

Build each object in four passes:
1. Paper.
2. Grey wash with a soft light gradient, light from the top-left.
3. 45deg hatching that thickens toward the shadow side: gap 5-9 px, line 1.1 px.
4. Contour that swells and tapers: 2.2 px, pressure varying about +-35%, tips thinning.

Greys by print density: ink 0.07; dark cloth 0.15-0.3; mid-tone wood or shutters 0.4-0.6; skin 0.85; white linen 0.9-0.95.

Figures: realistic proportions, about 7.5 heads tall. Build from rotating parts (head, torso, two arms, two legs) so the body can act. Identify by silhouette marks (a cap, a vest, a whistle).

Paint once. The street, each motorbike, each body part and the card borders are drawn to a canvas at load from a seeded PRNG and turned into images. After that, move transforms only.

## Print pass

Cheap layers laid over the gate, updated on a 24 fps grid:
- Flicker: dark veil, 2-15% opacity.
- Gate weave: +-2 px, with a rare 8 px perforation jump.
- Silver grain: a tiled texture shifted by random offsets.
- Scratches: one or two broken pale vertical lines.
- A few dust specks.
- Edge burn and a soft vignette, plus a soft dark rim inside the rounded aperture.

Frame: gate with 22 px rounded corners. Velvet curtains at both sides, folds from repeating gradients, lightly lit by spill from the screen. Black house behind.

## Colour

- Monochrome silver. `--teks` is ink, `--latar` is paper, and every grey is ink at some alpha over paper. A pale brand yields dark ink on pale stock; a dark brand yields a negative-looking light-on-dark print.
- `--utama`: the velvet (curtains = 26% mixed into black, folds down to 55% darker) and the house wash.
- `--aksen`: warms the burn and print edge, tints card text.
- Fixed for all brands: black intertitle card `--kartu` and cream lettering `--kertas`, tinted only slightly.
- Shop sign: `--teks` on `--latar-2`. Card text is cream on black, never a brand colour.
- At most one real colour per film, spent on the thing the film is about. Otherwise none.

## Type

- `--font-judul`: Playfair Display 700 for titles and shouts. Title card 190 px, shout figure 230 px, sign 38 px with 6 px tracking, THE END 74 px with 18 px tracking.
- `--font-isi`: Cormorant Garamond italic 500, narration and dialogue cards, 40-72 px.
- Card copy: a few words. A short film has 3 to 5 cards. A card never explains what the picture already shows.
- Card build: black ground, cream lettering, deco border. Shout = one heavy rule. Narration = thin rule, stepped-corner heavy rule and diamonds. Hold 2.2 s or more, longer with more words.

## Timing

- Hand-cranked feel: limbs and objects step on a 16 fps grid (`steps(duration × 16)` eases) while print layers run at 24 fps. The mix reads as projected film, not simply low frame rate.
- Chain reaction: an object tips over ~0.55 s with an accelerating ease (power2.in). Its neighbour starts 0.36 s later, before the first lands. Five objects take about 2 s.
- Deadpan: the face hardly moves. Head tilt 6-7deg, double take in 0.2 s. Arms and body do the acting. Wave = 4 half-swings of 0.5 s. Rescue = 0.3 s snap, then total stillness.
- Iris: opens from 40-60 px to full in 0.8-0.9 s (power2.inOut). Closes halfway in 1 s and holds 2 s or more.
- Push-in: 1 to 1.1 over 2.2 s (sine.inOut), final shot only.

## Camera

Vocabulary, not route. A period camera is heavy, so most shots are locked.
- Locked wide: cause and effect seen whole, the wait is the joke. Mechanical gag, crowd, process.
- Locked full: premise in one frame. A routine, a confrontation.
- Iris in or out: attention on one thing, a thought beginning or ending. A face, an object, a memory.
- Half-open iris, held: the figure shares a look with us. A wink, a secret, complicity.
- Slow push-in: tenderness, realisation. A kneel, a letter being read, a decision.
- Straight cut to a card: a handful of words reframes the next picture. A title, a shout, a punchline number.

Transitions allowed: iris, fade to black, straight cut. No dissolves inside a scene, no modern whip pans.

## Signature moves

- Chain in one take: A sets off B, B tips C, the audience waits, one finger stops the last. Fits: a supply chain gone wrong, how a rumour spreads, a workshop's busiest morning, a domino of small mishaps.
- Near-miss: a hand shuts exactly where the object would have dropped. Fits: catching a bus, a startup landing a deal in time, a goalkeeper, a teacher saving a demo.
- Intertitle twist: a card recasts the next shot in a few words. Fits: "Meanwhile…", a price as punchline, a statistic, a class title.
- Iris on the look: the iris halts half open so the figure can glance our way. Fits: a product that knows, a creator's sign-off, a history lesson's wink.
- Shout card: one heavy rule, enormous capitals, a brief tremor. Fits: a price, a date, a score, a warning.

## Avoid

- Even-width lines or flat grey without hatching: that is vector clip-art. Keep swell, wobble and hatch.
- Brand-colour fills inside the drawing. The picture stays silver; only the velvet takes `--utama`.
- Cutting inside the gag. Hold the shot locked until the card arrives.
- Long intertitles, or ones that explain the picture.
- Redrawing a big canvas every frame. Paint once, move images.
- Overdone print damage. Scratches: 1-3 thin lines. Dust: about 4 specks. Flicker: under 15%.

# Silent film: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.2, long 5.

## hook

- en: a black title card with a deco border and one narration line, the print still dark; an iris then opens on the street
- id: kartu judul hitam bergaris deco dan satu baris narasi; lalu iris membuka ke jalanan

## problem

- en: one locked wide shot: a small cause starts a chain, deadpan figure acting with the body, drawn at 16 fps
- id: satu bidikan lebar terkunci: sebab kecil memulai rantai, tokoh datar berakting dengan badan, 16 gambar per detik

## fact

- en: an intertitle card in narration style states the fact in a few words, then a straight cut back to the picture
- id: kartu teks bergaya narasi menyebut faktanya dalam beberapa kata, lalu potong lurus kembali ke gambar

## step

- en: each step is one action in the same wide shot, the next object triggered by the last; the wait is the joke
- id: tiap langkah satu aksi di bidikan lebar yang sama, benda berikutnya dipicu yang sebelumnya; menunggu adalah leluconnya

## compare

- en: split the frame in two shots, before and after, or two cards back to back with a heavy-rule shout on the second
- id: bagi bingkai jadi dua bidikan, sebelum dan sesudah, atau dua kartu berurutan dengan garis tebal teriak di kartu kedua

## number

- en: a shout card: heavy single rule, the figure in huge serif capitals, shaking for a third of a second, then held
- id: kartu teriak: satu garis tebal, angka kapital serif besar bergetar sepertiga detik, lalu ditahan

## proof

- en: the finished gag shown whole in the locked wide shot, evidence in frame, only flicker and grain moving
- id: lelucon yang sudah jadi tampak utuh di bidikan lebar terkunci, bukti di dalam gambar, hanya kedip dan butir yang bergerak

## offer

- en: a tender card (narration style, one line) then a slow push-in on the object or person who offers it
- id: kartu lembut satu baris lalu dorong masuk pelan ke benda atau orang yang menawarkannya

## cta

- en: the last card holds the contact in a framed intertitle, the print calming down; held 2 s on the black card
- id: kartu terakhir memuat kontak dalam bingkai deco, cetakan mulai tenang; ditahan 2 detik di kartu hitam

## payoff

- en: slow push-in on the deadpan face, the iris closes half-way and holds so the figure can look at us; THE END below; held 2 s
- id: dorong masuk pelan ke wajah datar, iris menutup separuh dan ditahan agar tokoh menatap kita; TAMAT di bawah; diam 2 detik

    <style>

      @font-face { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */

      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

      .tirai { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 262px; height: 1080px; }

    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="tirai kiri"></div>
      <div class="tirai kanan"></div>
      <div id="gerbang">
        <div id="film" class="dunia">
          <div class="adegan kartu" id="s1" data-role="hook">
            <div class="teks">
              <b style="font-size: 190px">Pak Odang</b>

            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="adegan kartu" id="s3" data-role="number">
            <div class="teks">
              <i style="font-size: 72px">Tarif parkir:</i>
              <b id="harga" style="font-size: 230px">Rp2.000</b>
              <i style="font-size: 52px; margin-top: 8px">ganti rugi: tidak ada</i>
            </div>

      </div>

        <canvas id="butir" width="1696" height="1336"></canvas>

    <script>
      const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
      const tok = (n) => css.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const INK = tok("--teks");
      const PAPER = tok("--latar");
      const [ir, ig, ib] = [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(INK.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
      // tinta di atas kertas: alpha = 1 - nilai abu-abu (0 gelap, 1 terang)
      const tone = (v) => `rgba(${ir},${ig},${ib},${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - v))})`;
      let seed = 11;
      const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) - 1) / 2147483646;
      const H = (n) => Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453 - Math.floor(Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453);
      const mk = (w, h) => Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), { width: w, height: h });
      const toImg = (c) => Object.assign(new Image(), { src: c["toDataURL"]("image/png") });
      const poly = (g, pts) => {
        g.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : g.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
        g.closePath();
      };
      const ell = (cx, cy, rx, ry, n = 26) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [cx + Math.cos((i / n) * 6.2832) * rx, cy + Math.sin((i / n) * 6.2832) * ry]);
      const rect = (x, y, w, h) => [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + h], [x, y + h]];
      // garis tinta berdenyut dan meruncing di ujung (ditiru dari mesin tinta sumbernya)
      function ink(g, pts, w = 2.4, loop = false) {
        const P = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
          const [a, b] = [pts[i], pts[i + 1]];
          const k = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) / 5));
          for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) P.push([a[0] + ((b[0] - a[0]) * j) / k, a[1] + ((b[1] - a[1]) * j) / k]);
        }
        const sd = rnd() * 40;
        const side = (s) => P.map((p, i) => {
          const a = P[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
          const b = P[Math.min(P.length - 1, i + 1)];
          const l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) || 1;
          const u = i / P.length;
          const hw = ((w * (0.78 + 0.34 * Math.sin(i * 0.6 + sd)) * (loop ? 1 : 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.min(1, u * 7, (1 - u) * 7))) / 2) * s;
          return [p[0] + ((b[1] - a[1]) / l) * hw, p[1] - ((b[0] - a[0]) / l) * hw];
        });
        g.fillStyle = INK;
        poly(g, [...side(1), ...side(-1).reverse()]);
        g.fill();
      }
      // satu bentuk gambar: kertas, cuci abu-abu, arsiran 45 derajat dari sisi bayangan, kontur tinta
      function form(g, pts, v, o = {}) {
        const [xs, ys] = [pts.map((p) => p[0]), pts.map((p) => p[1])];
        const [x0, x1, y0, y1] = [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs), Math.min(...ys), Math.max(...ys)];
        const wash = g.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1);
        wash.addColorStop(0, tone(v + 0.1));
        wash.addColorStop(1, tone(v - 0.1));
        const st = o.hatch ?? (v < 0.7 ? 0.9 - v : 0);
        const hg = g.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1);
        hg.addColorStop(0.2, tone(1));
        hg.addColorStop(1, tone(1 - st));
        g.save();
        poly(g, pts);
        g.clip();
        g.fillStyle = PAPER;
        g.fillRect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
        g.fillStyle = wash;
        g.fillRect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
        g.strokeStyle = hg;
        g.lineWidth = 1.1;
        g.beginPath();
        if (st > 0.05) for (let d = x0 - (y1 - y0); d < x1; d += o.gap ?? 6) [g.moveTo(d, y1), g.lineTo(d + y1 - y0, y0)];
        g.stroke();
        g.restore();
        if (o.line !== 0) ink(g, [...pts, pts[0]], o.line ?? 2.2, true);
      }
      const part = (w, h, fn) => {
        const c = mk(w, h);
        fn(c.getContext("2d"));
        return toImg(c);
      };
      // jalan: gedung belakang, toko dengan kanopi, lampu, trotoar berbatu, bayangan
      function paintStreet() {
        const c = mk(1440, 1080);
        const g = c.getContext("2d");
        [[20, 130, 400], [420, 40, 520], [960, 150, 460]].forEach(([x, y, w], k) => {
          form(g, rect(x, y, w, 770 - y), 0.78 - k * 0.04, { hatch: 0.25, gap: 9 });
          for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) form(g, rect(x + 30 + q * (w / 4.2), y + 40 + r * 100, w / 7, 70), 0.5, { gap: 5, line: 1.6 });
        });
        form(g, rect(300, 440, 960, 330), 0.82, { hatch: 0.2 });
        form(g, rect(360, 560, 560, 190), 0.38, { gap: 5 });
        form(g, rect(1010, 560, 170, 210), 0.3, { gap: 5 });
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) form(g, [[320 + i * 80, 456], [400 + i * 80, 456], [410 + i * 80, 540], [310 + i * 80, 540]], i % 2 ? 0.92 : 0.3, { hatch: i % 2 ? 0 : 0.5, line: 1.4, gap: 7 });
        form(g, rect(120, 130, 12, 640), 0.1, { line: 0 });
        form(g, [[100, 130], [190, 130], [180, 160], [110, 160]], 0.12, { line: 1.6 });
        g.fillStyle = PAPER;
        g.fillRect(0, 770, 1440, 310);
        g.strokeStyle = tone(0.55);
        g.lineWidth = 1.4;
        for (let r = 0; r < 14; r++)
          for (let q = 0; q < 34; q++) [g.beginPath(), g.ellipse(((q + (r % 2) / 2) * 1480) / 34 - 20 + rnd() * 6, 785 + r * r * 1.1 + r * 8, 20 + r * 1.5, 7 + r * 0.5, 0, 0, 6.3), g.stroke()];
        ink(g, [[0, 772], [1440, 772]], 5);
        g.fillStyle = tone(0.2);
        [300, 450, 600, 750, 900, 1274].forEach((x) => [g.beginPath(), g.ellipse(x, 934, x > 1000 ? 70 : 62, 12, 0, 0, 6.3), g.fill()]);
        return toImg(c);
      }
      // motor dilihat dari belakang supaya bisa rebah sejajar bidang gambar
      const paintBike = () => part(200, 340, (g) => {
        ink(g, [[26, 52], [174, 52]], 6);
        [[48, 52, 34, 8], [152, 52, 166, 8]].forEach(([a, b, c, d]) => [ink(g, [[a, b], [c, d]], 3), form(g, ell(c, d - 2, 17, 11), 0.8, { line: 2, hatch: 0 })]);
        [26, 174].forEach((x) => form(g, ell(x, 52, 9, 11), 0.1, { line: 1.5 }));
        form(g, [[74, 60], [126, 60], [118, 118], [82, 118]], 0.4);
        form(g, rect(80, 214, 40, 122), 0.08, { gap: 4 });
        form(g, [[44, 140], [156, 140], [168, 240], [32, 240]], 0.5);
        form(g, [[56, 232], [144, 232], [128, 292], [72, 292]], 0.3);
        form(g, ell(100, 134, 74, 20), 0.14, { line: 2.4 });
        form(g, rect(86, 170, 28, 12), 0.92, { line: 1.6 });
        form(g, rect(22, 196, 22, 12), 0.2, { line: 1.6 });
        form(g, rect(156, 196, 22, 12), 0.2, { line: 1.6 });
      });
      // bagian tubuh juru parkir: tiap bagian satu gambar supaya bisa diputar di sendinya
      const paintFigure = () => ({
        leg: part(60, 232, (g) => [form(g, [[16, 6], [44, 6], [42, 120], [46, 216], [14, 216], [18, 120]], 0.24, { gap: 5 }), form(g, [[6, 212], [48, 212], [58, 228], [4, 228]], 0.07, { hatch: 0 })]),
        torso: part(100, 172, (g) => {
          form(g, [[10, 0], [90, 0], [84, 168], [16, 168]], 0.34, { gap: 5 });
          form(g, [[38, 0], [62, 0], [50, 48]], 0.92, { hatch: 0, line: 1.6 });
          [88, 112].forEach((y) => form(g, rect(14, y, 72, 14), 0.9, { hatch: 0, line: 1.6 }));
        }),
        arm: part(42, 190, (g) => [form(g, [[8, 4], [34, 4], [30, 100], [32, 160], [10, 160], [12, 100]], 0.3, { gap: 5 }), form(g, ell(21, 172, 11, 14), 0.86, { line: 1.6 })]),
        head: part(96, 100, (g) => {
